name: ekoservice-backend
description: EkoService API - Enterprise-level open source backend

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && cd .. && docker compose run --rm -w /app/backend backend npm run db:push && docker compose run --rm -w /app/backend backend npm run db:seed
scripts.db:docker:push: cd .. && docker compose run --rm -u root -w /app/backend backend npx prisma db push
scripts.db:docker:seed: cd .. && docker compose run --rm -u root -w /app/backend backend npx tsx src/prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:docker:studio: cd .. && docker compose run --rm -u root -w /app/backend backend npx prisma studio
